caption: The drawing features two gray elephants shown from different angles, each with a red and gold saddle cloth covering their back and sides, as well as a structure resembling a box or a howdah on top of their backs. The elephant on the left is depicted in a three-quarter side view with its trunk raised and mouth open, while the elephant on the right is shown from a front view with its trunk straight down. The saddle cloth is primarily red with a gold border and geometric designs, and the box-like structure on top is gray, capped with a red lid. The background is a plain beige color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Iron Bank Elephant
